name: Ed Eastham
tagline: Portraits and figurative work in charcoal, oil and mixed media.

about.title: About
body: Ed Eastham is a contemporary artist based in Manchester working in charcoal, chalk, acrylic, oils and mixed media, with a focus on portraiture and the figure. His work explores the human form and inner emotions of the subject. Specialising in portraiture and figurative life drawing Ed captures the quiet, unseen narratives of human experience. Rather than aiming for simple replication, the works relies heavily on strong tonal values and dramatic lighting to sculpt a sense of mood and presence. By balancing light and shadow, Ed invites viewers into an intimate space, evoking powerful feelings and a connection with each subject.

commission.title: Commission
body: Portraits and figurative works can be commissioned in charcoal, oil or mixed media, worked from your photographs or from sittings.
Send a short note with what you have in mind, the size you would like and any photographs, and Ed will reply with timings and a price.

steps.d: Email a short note with what you have in mind: who or what, the size you would like, and any photographs.
Ed replies with a medium, a size and a price. Charcoal, oil or mixed media, worked from your photographs or from sittings.
Progress photographs along the way, then the finished work delivered or collected, framed if you would like.
